5032.text: By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter,

5033.text: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God's people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;

5034.text: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

5035.text: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

5036.text: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

5037.text: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

5038.text: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.

5039.text: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, did not perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

5040.text: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;

5041.text: who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

5042.text: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

5043.text: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

5044.text: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

5045.text: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated

5046.text: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

5047.text: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, did not receive the promise,

5048.text: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

5049.text: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

5050.text: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, disregarding its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

5051.text: For consider him who has endured such hostility from sinners against himself, that you do not grow weary, fainting in your souls.

5052.text: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;

5053.text: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, "My son, do not take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

5054.text: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives."

5055.text: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father does not discipline?

5056.text: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.

5057.text: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?

5058.text: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

5059.text: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.

5060.text: Therefore, lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

5061.text: and make straight paths for your feet, so that which is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

5062.text: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

5063.text: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;

5064.text: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his own birthright for one meal.

5065.text: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

5066.text: For you have not come to something that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and darkness, gloom, and storm,

5067.text: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

5068.text: for they could not stand that which was commanded, "If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned;"

5069.text: and so fearful was the appearance, that Moses said, "I am terrified and trembling."

5070.text: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

5071.text: to the assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

5072.text: to Jesus, the mediator of a New Covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

5073.text: See that you do not refuse him who speaks. For if they did not escape when they refused him who warned on the Earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

5074.text: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, "Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens."

5075.text: This phrase, "Yet once more," signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

5076.text: So since we are receiving a Kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us give thanks, through which we may offer service pleasing to God, with reverence and awe,

5077.text: for our God is a consuming fire.

5079.text: Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

5080.text: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

5081.text: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

5082.text: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, "I will never leave you or forsake you."

5083.text: So that with good courage we say, "The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?"

5084.text: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

5085.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

5086.text: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

5087.text: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

5088.text: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

5089.text: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

5090.text: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

5091.text: For we do not have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

5092.text: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

5093.text: But do not forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

5094.text: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

5095.text: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

5096.text: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

5097.text: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

5098.text: make you complete in every good thing to do his will, working in us that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever. Amen.

5099.text: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

5100.text: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

5101.text: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.

5103.text: Jacob, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Diaspora: Greetings.

5104.text: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

5105.text: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

5106.text: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

5107.text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.

5108.text: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

5109.text: For let that man not think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

5110.text: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

5111.text: But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

5112.text: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

5113.text: For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.

5114.text: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which he promised to those who love him.

5115.text: Let no man say when he is tempted, "I am tempted by God," for God cannot be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

5116.text: But each one is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

5117.text: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, brings forth death.

5118.text: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.

5119.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

5120.text: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

5121.text: This you know, my beloved brothers. But let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

5122.text: for the anger of man does not accomplish the righteousness of God.

5123.text: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

5124.text: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

5125.text: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

5126.text: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

5127.text: But he who looks into the perfect Law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

5128.text: If anyone thinks himself to be religious while he does not bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man's religion is worthless.

5129.text: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

5130.text: My brothers, do not hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.

5131.text: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;

5132.text: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, "Sit here in a good place;" but you tell the poor man, "Stand there," or "Sit by my footstool;"

5133.text: haven't you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

5134.text: Listen, my beloved brothers. Did not God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

5135.text: But you have dishonored the poor man. Do not the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

5136.text: Do not they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

5137.text: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you do well.

5138.text: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

5139.text: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

5140.text: For he who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not commit murder." Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

5141.text: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.

5142.text: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

5143.text: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

5144.text: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

5145.text: and one of you tells them, "Go in peace, be warmed and filled;" and yet you did not give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

5146.text: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

5147.text: Yes, a man will say, "You have faith, and I have works." Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.

5148.text: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.

5149.text: But do you want to know, foolish man, that faith apart from works is dead?

5150.text: Wasn't Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

5151.text: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;

5152.text: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, "Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness;" and he was called the friend of God.

5153.text: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.

5154.text: In like manner was not Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?

5155.text: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

5156.text: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

5157.text: For in many things we all stumble. If anyone does not stumble in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.

5158.text: Now if we put bits into the horses' mouths so that they may obey us, we guide their whole body.

5159.text: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

5160.text: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

5161.text: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by hell.

5162.text: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and thing in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind.

5163.text: But nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

5164.text: With it we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who are made in the image of God.

5165.text: Out of the same mouth comes forth blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

5166.text: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

5167.text: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Nor is salt water able to produce sweet.

5168.text: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

5169.text: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, do not boast and do not lie against the truth.

5170.text: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

5171.text: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

5172.text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, without hypocrisy.

5173.text: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

5174.text: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Do not they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

5175.text: You lust, and do not have. You kill, covet, and cannot obtain. You fight and make war. You do not have, because you do not ask.

5176.text: You ask, and do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it for your pleasures.

5177.text: You adulteresses, do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

5178.text: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, "The Spirit which He made to dwell in us yearns jealously"?

5179.text: But He gives more grace. Therefore it says, "God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble."

5180.text: Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

5181.text: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

5182.text: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

5183.text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

5184.text: Do not speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother or judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

5185.text: Only one is the lawgiver and judge, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?

5186.text: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow let us go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit."

5187.text: Whereas you do not know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away .

5188.text: For you ought to say, "If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that."

5189.text: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

5190.text: To him therefore who knows to do good, and does not do it, to him it is sin.

5191.text: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

5192.text: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

5193.text: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you, and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

5194.text: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of hosts.

5195.text: You have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts in a day of slaughter.

5196.text: You have condemned, you have murdered the righteous one. He does not resist you.

5197.text: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

5198.text: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is near.

5199.text: Do not grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won't be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

5200.text: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

5201.text: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

5202.text: But above all things, my brothers, do not swear, neither by heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath; but let your "yes" be "yes," and your "no," "no;" so that you do not fall under judgment.

5203.text: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

5204.text: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord,

5205.text: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

5206.text: Therefore confess your sins to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

5207.text: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it did not rain on the earth for three years and six months.

5208.text: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth brought forth its fruit.

5209.text: My brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth, and someone turns him back,

5210.text: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death, and will cover a multitude of sins.

5211.text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Diaspora in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

5212.text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

5213.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy became our father again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

5214.text: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that does not fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

5215.text: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

5216.text: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been put to grief in various trials,

5217.text: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ-

5218.text: whom not having seen you love; in whom, though now you do not see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory-

5219.text: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

5220.text: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

5221.text: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ, which was in them, pointed to, when he predicted the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that would follow them.

5222.text: To them it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to you, they ministered these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

5223.text: Therefore, prepare your minds for action, be sober and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ-

5224.text: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

5225.text: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;

5226.text: because it is written, "You shall be holy; for I am holy."

5227.text: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man's work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear:

5228.text: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

5229.text: but with precious blood, as of a faultless and pure lamb, the blood of Christ;

5230.text: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed at the end of times for your sake,

5231.text: who through Him are believers in God, who raised Him from the dead, and gave Him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

5232.text: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from a pure heart fervently:

5233.text: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the living and abiding Word of God.

5234.text: For, "All flesh is like grass, and all it's glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

5235.text: but the word of the Lord endures forever." This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

5236.text: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

5237.text: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that you may grow thereby,

5238.text: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:

5239.text: coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

5240.text: You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

5241.text: Because it is contained in Scripture, "Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen, and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed."

5242.text: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who do not believe, "The stone which the builders rejected, has become the chief cornerstone,"

5243.text: and, "a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense." For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

5244.text: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:

5245.text: who in time past were no people, but now are God's people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

5246.text: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

5247.text: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they see, glorify God in the day of visitation.

5248.text: Subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

5249.text: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

5250.text: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

5251.text: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

5252.text: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

5253.text: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

5254.text: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

5255.text: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

5256.text: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

5257.text: who did not sin, "neither was deceit found in his mouth."

5258.text: Who, when he was cursed, did not curse back. When he suffered, did not threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously;

5259.text: who his own self bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by his stripes you were healed.

5260.text: For you were going astray like sheep; but now have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

5261.text: In like manner, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; so that, even if any do not obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word;

5262.text: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

5263.text: Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;

5264.text: but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.

5265.text: For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

5266.text: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.

5267.text: You husbands, in like manner, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that your prayers may not be hindered.

5268.text: Finally, be all like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, humble,

5269.text: not rendering evil for evil, or reviling for reviling; but instead blessing; because to this were you called, that you may inherit a blessing.

5270.text: For, "He who would love life, and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking deceit.

5271.text: Let him turn away from evil, and do good. Let him seek peace, and pursue it.

5272.text: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."

5273.text: Now who is he who will harm you, if you become zealous of that which is good?

5274.text: But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. "Do not fear what they fear, neither be troubled."

5275.text: But sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord; and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with humility and fear:

5276.text: having a good conscience; so that when they speak evil against you, they may be put to shame who slander your good manner of life in Christ.

5277.text: For it is better, if it is God's will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.

5278.text: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;

5279.text: in which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

5280.text: who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

5281.text: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you-not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

5282.text: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

5283.text: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;

5284.text: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

5285.text: For enough time in the past has been spent doing the will of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

5286.text: They think it is strange that you do not run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming:

5287.text: who will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

5288.text: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

5289.text: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

5290.text: Above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

5291.text: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

5292.text: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

5293.text: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

5294.text: Beloved, do not be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you, to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

5295.text: But because you are partakers of Christ's sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

5296.text: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

5297.text: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men's matters.

5298.text: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.

5299.text: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who do not obey the Good News of God?

5300.text: "If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?"

5301.text: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

5302.text: Therefore, I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed.

5303.text: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, according to God; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

5304.text: neither as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

5305.text: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that does not fade away.

5306.text: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, towards one another; for "God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble."

5307.text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

5308.text: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

5309.text: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

5310.text: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

5311.text: And the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore, confirm, strengthen and establish you.

5312.text: To him be the power forever. Amen.

5313.text: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it!

5314.text: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you; and so does Mark, my son.

5315.text: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ.

5316.text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

5317.text: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

5318.text: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue;

5319.text: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

5320.text: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

5321.text: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control patience; and in patience godliness;

5322.text: and in godliness brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

5323.text: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful to the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

5324.text: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

5325.text: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

5326.text: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

5327.text: Therefore I will be ready always to remind you of these things, though you know them, and are established in the present truth.

5328.text: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you;

5329.text: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

5330.text: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

5331.text: For we did not follow cunningly devised tales, when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

5332.text: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

5333.text: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

5334.text: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns, and the morning star arises in your hearts:

5335.text: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

5336.text: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but men spoke from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

5337.text: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

5338.text: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

5339.text: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old does not linger, and their destruction is not asleep.

5340.text: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to the lower parts of hell, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved for judgment;

5341.text: and did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a proclaimer of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly;

5342.text: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live ungodly;

5343.text: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

5344.text: (for that righteous man dwelling among them, was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds):

5345.text: the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment;

5346.text: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement, and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries;

5347.text: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, do not bring a railing judgment against them before the Lord.

5348.text: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

5349.text: suffering the penalty as the wages of evil; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

5350.text: having eyes full of adultery, and who cannot cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed; children of cursing;

5351.text: forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

5352.text: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A mute donkey spoke with a man's voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

5353.text: These are wells without water, and mists driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved.

5354.text: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who barely escape from those who live in error;

5355.text: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

5356.text: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

5357.text: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

5358.text: It has happened to them according to the true proverb, "The dog turns to his own vomit again," and "the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire."

5359.text: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you;

5360.text: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and the commandment of the Lord and Savior through your apostles:

5361.text: knowing this first, that in the last days scoffers will come, mocking and walking after their own lusts,

5362.text: and saying, "Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation."

5363.text: For this they willfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water, by the word of God;

5364.text: by which means the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished.

5365.text: But the heavens that now are, and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

5366.text: But do not forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

5367.text: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but is patient with you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

5368.text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief; in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat, and the earth and the works that are in it will be disclosed.

5369.text: Therefore since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

5370.text: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

5371.text: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

5372.text: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without blemish and blameless in his sight.

5373.text: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you;

5374.text: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

5375.text: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

5376.text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

5377.text: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

5378.text: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

5379.text: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you also, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

5380.text: And we write these things, that our joy may be fulfilled.

5381.text: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

5382.text: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and do not tell the truth.

5383.text: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.

5384.text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

5385.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

5386.text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

5387.text: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

5388.text: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

5389.text: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

5390.text: One who says, "I know him," and does not keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

5391.text: But whoever keeps his word, God's love has truly been perfected in him. This is how we know that we are in him:

5392.text: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

5393.text: Beloved, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard.

5394.text: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shines.

5395.text: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother, is in the darkness even until now.

5396.text: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

5397.text: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

5398.text: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

5399.text: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

5400.text: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

5401.text: Do not love the world, neither the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father's love is not in him.

5402.text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not the Father's, but is the world's.

5403.text: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God's will remains forever.

5404.text: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Anti-Christ is coming, even now many anti-Christs have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

5405.text: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

5406.text: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

5407.text: I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

5408.text: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Anti-Christ, he who denies the Father and the Son.

5409.text: Whoever denies the Son, the same does not have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

5410.text: As for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

5411.text: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

5412.text: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

5413.text: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you do not need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you remain in him.

5414.text: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

5415.text: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone also who practices righteousness is born of him.

5416.text: Behold, how great a love the Father has bestowed on us, that we should be called children of God; and such we are. For this cause the world does not know us, because it did not know him.

5417.text: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. We know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.

5418.text: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

5419.text: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

5420.text: You know that he was revealed to take away sins, and in him is no sin.

5421.text: Whoever remains in him does not sin. Whoever sins hasn't seen him, neither knows him.

5422.text: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

5423.text: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

5424.text: Whoever is born of God does not commit sin, because his seed remains in him; and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

5425.text: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever does not do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who does not love his brother.

5426.text: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another;

5427.text: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one, and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

5428.text: Do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.

5429.text: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who does not love remains in death.

5430.text: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

5431.text: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

5432.text: But whoever has the world's goods, and sees his brother in need, and closes his heart of compassion against him, how does the love of God remain in him?

5433.text: Little children, let us not love in word only, neither with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

5434.text: And by this we will know that we are of the truth, and persuade our heart before him,

5435.text: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

5436.text: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

5437.text: and whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

5438.text: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded us.

5439.text: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

5440.text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

5441.text: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

5442.text: and every spirit who does not confess Jesus is not of God, and this is the spirit of the Anti-Christ, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

5443.text: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

5444.text: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

5445.text: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God does not listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

5446.text: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves is born of God, and knows God.

5447.text: He who does not love does not know God, for God is love.

5448.text: By this God's love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

5449.text: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

5450.text: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

5451.text: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

5452.text: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

5453.text: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

5454.text: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

5455.text: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

5456.text: In this love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so are we in this world.

5457.text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

5458.text: We love, because he first loved us.

5459.text: If a man says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen, cannot love God whom he has not seen.

5460.text: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

5461.text: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

5462.text: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.

5463.text: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

5464.text: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.

5465.text: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

5466.text: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

5467.text: For there are three who testify:

5468.text: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

5469.text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God's testimony that he has testified concerning his Son.

5470.text: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who does not believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

5471.text: The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

5472.text: He who has the Son has the life. He who does not have God's Son does not have the life.

5473.text: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life.

5474.text: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

5475.text: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

5476.text: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is a sin leading to death. I do not say that he should make a request concerning this.

5477.text: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is a sin not leading to death.

5478.text: We know that whoever is born of God does not sin, but he who was born of God protects him, and the evil one does not touch him.

5479.text: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

5480.text: We know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

5481.text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

5482.text: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all those who know the truth;

5483.text: for the truth's sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

5484.text: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

5485.text: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

5486.text: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

5487.text: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

5488.text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Anti-Christ.

5489.text: Watch yourselves, that you do not lose the things which we have accomplished, but that you receive a full reward.

5490.text: Whoever goes on and does not remain in the teaching of Christ, does not have God. He who remains in the teaching, the same has both the Father and the Son.

5491.text: If anyone comes to you, and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house, and do not welcome him,

5492.text: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil works.

5493.text: Having many things to write to you, I do not want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

5494.text: The children of your chosen sister greet you.

5495.text: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

5496.text: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

5497.text: For I rejoiced greatly, when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

5498.text: I have no greater joy than this, to hear about my children walking in truth.

5499.text: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

5500.text: They have testified about your love before the church. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a manner worthy of God,

5501.text: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the pagans.

5502.text: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

5503.text: I wrote something to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, does not accept what we say.

5504.text: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, neither does he himself receive the brothers, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the church.

5505.text: Beloved, do not imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn't seen God.

5506.text: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

5507.text: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

5508.text: but I hope to see you soon, and we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

5509.text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of Jacob, to those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

5510.text: Mercy to you and peace and love be multiplied.

5511.text: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

5512.text: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

5513.text: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.

5514.text: Angels who did not keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

5515.text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities around them, having, in the same way as these, given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

5516.text: Yet in like manner these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

5517.text: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, "May the Lord rebuke you!"

5518.text: But these speak evil of whatever things they do not know. What they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, they are destroyed in these things.

5519.text: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah's rebellion.

5520.text: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn leaves without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

5521.text: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

5522.text: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, "Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

5523.text: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him."

5524.text: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts (and their mouth speaks proud things), showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

5525.text: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

5526.text: They said to you that "In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts."

5527.text: These are they who cause divisions, and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

5528.text: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

5529.text: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

5530.text: On some have compassion, who are in doubt,

5531.text: and some save, snatching them out of the fire, and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

5532.text: Now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

5533.text: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
